title: Bole shabbir meri jaan Akbar
body:
bole shabbir meri jaa'n akber
yu'n na lo mera imteha'n akber
kaise marne ki doon riza tumko
tum ho laila ki qalb-o-jaa'n akber
<<DIVIDER>>
mai bhi peechhe tumhare aata hu'n
is qadar tum na ho rawaa'n akber
aye mere laal is zaeefi me
ran me dhoondu tumhe kaha'n akber
<<DIVIDER>>
tum nigaho'n se ho gaye oujhal
meri nazro'n me hai dhuwa'n akber
dekh kar zakhm tere seene ka
dil pe chalti hai barchhiya'n akber
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha ka hai zakhm seene me
khoon seene se hai rawa'n akber
maa se milna hai chalke qaime me
mout ki lo na hichkiya'n akber
<<DIVIDER>>
uthgaye tum jaha'n se ghurbat me
sehra baandhegi kisko maa akber
umme laila se kya kahu'n jaakar
kuch to farmao meri jaan akber
<<DIVIDER>>
roke kehti thi maa yehi mazher phir sunaado mujhe azaa'n akber
